summary: The Tempest Throne is the storm‑crowned seat of the Air Sovereign. Lightning arcs, cyclone pillars, and tempest‑forged platforms form the apex of elemental air power.
history: Formed when the highest winds condensed into a stable storm crown.
Lightning arcs grew as elemental pressure accumulated around the throne.
Cyclone pillars formed from spiraling currents of ancient air force.
The Air Sovereign claimed the throne after mastering the primordial tempest.
